summary: AgriSmart re-tested end-to-end after upgrade. Backend: 31/32 pytest cases pass. Frontend: login (with Hindi i18n), Dashboard (all 5 sensor cards + badges + quick links + simulated banner), Farm wizard 3-step flow, Farm switcher, Settings (profile/language/system-status with 'Not connected · Simulated demo data'), Fertilizer (Low/Medium/High correctly rated), Crop Recommend (autofill + 5 top-crop rows + model-metrics), Irrigation (recommendation card, reason, data-source badge), Analytics (all 5 charts + range buttons + PDF button + simulated note), Chatbot (farm context banner, quick questions, assistant reply with Listen button, clear-history) all working. 401 handling redirects to /login when localStorage token is invalid.

minor.issue: When user+assistant messages are inserted with identical timestamps (same insert_many call), retrieved order is non-deterministic and can return [assistant, user] instead of chronological [user, assistant]. Reproduction: DELETE history, POST /api/chatbot, GET history -> observed msgs[0].role='assistant'. Fix: give assistant a timestamp +1ms, or add a monotonic sequence field, or sort by (created_at, role_priority).

ui_bugs.issue: On invalid token the app correctly redirects to /login, but the 'Session expired' toast text was not observed on the page (either it disappears too quickly or the exact copy differs). Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix chatbot history ordering when user+assistant share the same created_at (see minor backend issue).
Optional: increase 'Session expired' toast duration or verify the copy string ('Session expired' vs another wording) so it is visible/testable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py inserts user+assistant chat messages with identical ISO timestamps -> ordering ambiguity (documented above).
server.py is ~840 lines; consider splitting routes into modules (auth, farms, sensors, ai, admin) for maintainability.

farm_report endpoint calls recommend_irrigation(farm_id, current_user) which re-runs get_owned_farm, fetch_sensor_reading, and safe_weather; consider passing already-fetched sensor/weather to avoid duplicate work and API calls per PDF generation.

success_rate.frontend: 98% (all critical flows pass, minor 401 toast copy not verified)
